statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate arrhythmic events with hemodynamic status
CPT 93247 long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring is indicated
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before the service was rendered
